ios.desc:
Professional English-to-IPA Transcription for Teachers, Students, and Researchers.

Phonetic Formatter is a high-precision linguistic tool for clean, consistent IPA conversion of English text. Powered by the CMU Pronouncing Dictionary for North American English, it helps you prepare classroom handouts, study complex literature, or master pronunciation—processing extensive text with unmatched precision.

>>> What You Can Do

Versatile Text Input Methods
* Flexible Input Options: Type or paste extensive texts directly into the workspace for instant processing.
* Share from Other Apps: Import English text from Safari, Notes, Mail, and more via the iOS Share menu.
* On-Device OCR & Scanning: Instantly scan physical books, worksheets, or documents to extract text.

Convert Text to IPA
* Long-Form Support: Optimized to process entire articles, essays, and lesson chapters in seconds—eliminating manual dictionary lookups.
* Custom Logic: Automatically handles punctuation, contractions, and proper nouns for natural sentence flow, with proprietary algorithms for stress marking, sentence rhythm, and smart symbol wrapping.

Professional Layout
* Sentence-Level Format: A clean, alternating layout where original sentences and their phonetic blocks appear in sequence.
* Word-by-Word Format: Displays each sentence followed by a detailed, line-by-line breakdown of every word and its corresponding IPA.
* IPA Only Format: A streamlined, distraction-free display that hides the original English text for focused phonetic reading and practice.
* Phonetic Variants: Tap any highlighted blue word to explore alternative pronunciations and choose which one to use when reading, copying, or exporting results.

Enhanced Reading View
* Full-screen reading view with adjustable font sizes, line spacing, and token spacing to match how you read best.

Flexible Output Options
* Copy to Clipboard: One tap to copy formatted results for seamless integration into your workflow.
* Export to TXT, DOCX, and PDF: Save your results for printing, handouts, and study guides.

>>> Access & Privacy
* Dark Mode for comfortable reading.
* Available on iPhone and iPad.
* IPA conversion runs on your device, and the text you enter is not uploaded to our servers.

>>> Free vs Pro

Included for Free
• Sentence transcription
• IPA-only format
• Full-screen reading view
• Copy results
• View alternative pronunciations

Pro Features
(Monthly subscription or one-time lifetime purchase.)
• Unlimited daily transcripti
